explanation.solution: We make it simple. Instead of paying $3,000 – $10,000 upfront, you get everything for a simple monthly subscription: we design, host and maintain your website so you can focus on running your business.

terms.title: Terms of Service

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Innexar's services, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and all applicable laws and regulations.

services.title: Plan Scope and Included Deliverables
services.content: Our Website as a Service plans include design, implementation, hosting, and maintenance with monthly revisions according to the selected tier: Starter includes up to 5 pages and 1 monthly revision; Business includes up to 20 pages and 3 monthly revisions; Pro includes up to 20 pages and priority revisions under fair-use policy.

hosting.title: Commitment, Billing, and Early Cancellation
hosting.content: All website subscription plans have a minimum 6-month commitment and are billed monthly. If canceled before the end of the minimum term, an early cancellation fee equivalent to 50% of the remaining months applies.

intellectualProperty.title: Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content: The website content and software developed for the client are subject to the ownership terms defined in the specific service agreement signed during onboarding.

limitations.title: Limitations of Liability
limitations.content: Innexar shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use our services.

governingLaw.title: Governing Law
governingLaw.content: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Florida, United States, without regard to its conflict of law provisions.

terms.footerNote: For any questions regarding these terms, please contact us at sales@innexar.app

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.content: We collect information you provide directly to us during checkout and onboarding (name, email, phone, business details) and automated usage data via cookies to improve our services.

dataUsage.title: How We Use Your Data Across Plans
dataUsage.content: Your data is used to provide your selected plan (Starter, Business, or Pro), process recurring payments, deliver monthly revisions, communicate project updates, and improve website performance.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with trusted third-party service providers (such as Stripe for payments and infrastructure providers for hosting) when required to deliver your contracted plan.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies to personalize content, analyze traffic, and for marketing purposes. You can manage your preferences through our Cookie Consent banner.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. Contact us to exercise these rights.

privacy.footerNote: This privacy policy is subject to change. Please review it periodically.
